canonical_definition: Truthfulness is the tendency to generate factually correct, non-misleading content while avoiding hallucinations, falsehoods, or imitative errors, particularly under conditions of noise, bias, or erroneous input. It is often operationalized through benchmarks like TruthfulQA and distinguished from honesty by emphasizing objective factual accuracy over the model's internal beliefs or intentions. Some definitions further highlight robustness in detecting nonexistent entities and maintaining consistency under perturbations, though consensus centers on factual reliability as a core dimension of model safety and alignment.
